book.name: Yohana
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Yohana

content: Yesu nde mzabibu wa chakaka
“Nepani nde mzabibu wa chakaka, na Atati wangu nde ndeme.
Kila limbandi mkati jangu langakupambika mapambiku, Atati wangu aliheketa. Na kila limbandi lelipambika mapambiku, Atati wangu alikulaghalila, nahuli lipambikaje mapambiku nakanopi.
Sajenu mwehapa njomwi kubha mwanyahi kwa ndandi ja malobhi ghala ghanakumpwaghile.

Mtamaje mkati jangu, na nepani mkati jinu. Ngati bhela limbandi molilepalela kupambika mapambiku kanjika jaki, nangakutama mkati ja mzabibu, bhelabhela na mwehapa ngamuwezi kupambika mapambiku, nangakutama mkati jangu.”
“Nepani nde mzabibu, na mwehapa nde mambandi. Joatama mkati jangu, na nepani mkati jaki, jonihoju apambika mapambiku nakanopi. Maghambu panga kubha nepani, mwehapa ngamuwezi kutenda chindu chokapi.
Mundu jokapi jwangakutama mkati jangu, anaalekalikaje kunja ngati limbandi na kunyala. Na bhandu anabhabhonganaje, na kughalekela pamoto, na kutinyika.
Ngati mwehapa anantami mkati jangu, na malobhi ghangu anaghatemi mkati jinu, ndobhaje chokapi chemchipala nanamu anampataje.
Bhela alumbalikaje Atati wangu, kwa bhela mompambaki mapambiku nakanopi, na kwa indela jeniheji anambya bhabhulwa bhangu.
Ngati Atati moambali nepani, nanatu monumpali mwehapa. Njendalyaje kutama mu upalu wangu.
Ngati anamkamwili amuli yangu, anamtamaje mu upalu wangu, ngati bhela nepani monikamulile amuli ya Atati wangu, na kutama mu upalu waki.
“Numpwaghili mambu ghanihagha, nahuli chiheku changu chibya mkati jinu, na chiheku chinu chikubhaje kamili.
Amuli jangu nde ajeji: Mpalanaye ngati nepani monumpali mwehapa.
Njeta mundu joabhi na upalu ukolongwa kupeta ghongone, mundu kuubhoha womi waki kwa ndandi ja bhakochi bhaki.
Mwehapa mbi bhakochi bhangu, ngati anantendiki ghanundaghalakile.
Nganundohi bhatumika kabhete, kwa ndandi mtumika ngacheamanya cheatenda bambo waki. Nambu mwehapa nundohiki bhakochi bhangu, maghambu numpwaghi mambu ghokapi ghanyowini kwa Atati wangu.

Nga mwehapa mwemunhawili nepani, nambu nepani nde nenunhawili mwehapa, nanatu numbekiki njenda mkapambikaje mapambiku, na mapambiku ghinu ghapataje kutamakila, nahuli lokapi lemundobha Atati kupetela lihina langu, ampekyaje.
Haghagha nundaghalaki mwehapa, nahuli mpalanaje.”
Ndema ubhahakalila bhabhulwa
“Ngati bhandu bha pundema anabhunhakali mwehapa, mmanyi kubha bhakanhakali nepani mangane ja kunhakali mwehapa.

Ngati mkabhi bhandu bha pundema, ndema ukabya umpaliki bhabhabhi bhaki. Nambu kwa kubha mwehapa nga mabhandu bha pundema, nambu nepani nakunhawili kuhuma pundema, kwa ndandi jeniheji bhandu bha pundema bhunhakalila.

Nkombukaje malobhi ghangu ghanakumpwaghile, ‘Mtumika nga nkolongwa kupeta bambo waki. Ngati bhakang'ahiki nepani, anabhung'aha na mwehapa bhelabhela, na ngati bhakakamwi malobhi ghangu, anabhakamulaje na malobhi ghinu bhelabhela.’
Nambu ghanihagha ghokapi anabhuntendilaje mwehapa kwa ndandi ja lihina langu, maghambu ngachebhummanyi jombi joandumike.
Ngati nganakahikiki na kupwagha nabhu, ngabhakabhi na mahoku, nambu sajenu ngachebhabhili na cha kukopunganela kwa mahoku ghabhu.
Jola joanhakali nepani, anhakalila na Atati wangu bhelabhela.
Ngati nganakatendiki kwabhu mahengu ghangakughatenda mundu jongi jokapi, ngabhakabhi na mahoku. Nambu sajenu bhaweni ngangachu yenu na bhakali kutuhakalila nepani papamu na Atati wangu.
Nambu bhatendiki bhenibhela nahuli malobhi ghala ghaghalembakiki mu Shelia jabhu ghapitalyaje, ghaghapwagha, ‘Bhakanhakali waka.’ ”
“Nambu paanahikaje Mjangatila hoju, joananuntumaje kwinu kuhuma kwa Atati, yani, Roho Mhuhu wa chakaka joahuma kwa Atati, najombi anaanandilaje nepane.
Mwehapa nanamu mnandila, kwa ndandi mkabhi papamu na nepani kutumbu pakutumbula.”
